topics.title: White House Scandals, Lie Detector Tests & Odd Stories
topics.summary: The broadcast discusses several unusual stories including allegations involving a former White House mistress (Lucy Mercer), a school bus driver arrested for sex with a minor, and the results of a lie detector test administered to Terry Nichols regarding the Oklahoma City bombing. The show also explores a controversial movie adaptation of *Lolita* alongside discussions about breast examinations.

topics.title: Breast Exams and Dietary Fads
topics.summary: The hosts discuss concerns about delayed mammograms, their impact on cancer detection, and the shape of breasts after squeezing. They then transition into a tangential conversation regarding dietary fads like Atkins, weight loss attempts, smells, bodily functions, marital relationships, and personal grooming habits.

topics.title: Dietary Struggles and Celebrity Kids
topics.summary: The show centers on a man’s unusual diet involving VHUs and fat-free chocolate milk alongside discussions about the pressures faced by celebrity children like Cody House, who are thrust into public life potentially exploited for fame. The conversation also touches upon narcissistic tendencies within families and challenges of protecting young people from excessive exposure.

topics.title: Strange Phone Calls & Pipe Bombs
topics.summary: Howard engages in bizarre conversations involving pipe bombs and threats while discussing callers with unusual stories – including one man claiming he has a bomb in his pants, another detailing an incident with a truck explosion, and yet another describing a health maintenance organization. Daniel Jones repeatedly threatens to detonate explosives.

topics.title: Jerry Jugs, Swiss Guards and Toll Collectors
topics.summary: During a radio show discussion, callers discuss a man named Jerry who owns a ‘Jerry jug’ for carrying liquids. Later, they cover the suicide of a Swiss guard commander followed by an investigation into toll collectors pocketing money from tolls; then address voter concerns regarding anti-discrimination laws in Icelati, Michigan and reflect on a 1983 synagogue shooting.

topics.title: Teenage Rampage & Movie Reviews
topics.summary: A Saturday morning broadcast includes a report on a teenager arrested for assaulting police after losing phone privileges, alongside discussions about the box office hit ‘Game’ and its star Mark Wahlberg. A review of Adrian Lyne's film 'Lolita' is presented with critical commentary from callers including opinions on Phil Collins’ upcoming tour and basketball player Patrick Ewing.
